disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with sections 144A.18 to 144A.27 or the board's standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revoke or suspend the license or permit of a nursing home administrator or acting administrator or an assisted living director or acting director who fails to comply with sections 144A.18 to 144A.27 or the board's standards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction in a court of competent jurisdiction of certain offenses listed in section 214.10.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A board shall initiate proceedings to suspend or revoke a license or shall refuse to renew a license of a person licensed by the board who is convicted in a court of competent jurisdiction of violating section 609.2231, subdivision 8, 609.23, 609.231, 609.2325, 609.233, 609.2335, 609.234, 609.465, 609.466, 609.52, or 609.72, subdivision 3.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapters 214 - 215 — Examining And Licensing Boards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being in arrears in child support or maintenance payments as ordered by a court or public authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a licensing board receives an order from a court or a child support magistrate or a notice from a public authority responsible for child support enforcement under section 518A.66 dealing with suspension of a license of a person found by the court or the public authority to be in arrears in child support or maintenance payments, or both, the board shall, within 30 days of receipt of the order or public authority notice, suspend the license
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapters 214 - 215 — Examining And Licensing Boards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentional nonpayment, default, or breach of a federal educational loan, loan repayment, or service conditional scholarship program.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A health-related licensing board may refuse to grant a license or may impose disciplinary action against a person regulated by the board if the person is intentionally in nonpayment, default, or breach of a repayment or service obligation under any federal educational loan, loan repayment, or service conditional scholarship program.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapters 214 - 215 — Examining And Licensing Boards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of insurance fraud or conviction relating to fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A health-related board may revoke, suspend, condition, limit, restrict, or qualify a license to practice when clear and convincing evidence indicates the licensee has committed insurance fraud or subsequent to a conviction relating to fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapters 214 - 215 — Examining And Licensing Boards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continued practice by the regulated person presents an imminent risk of serious harm.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: when a health-related licensing board receives a complaint regarding a regulated person and has probable cause to believe that the regulated person has violated a statute or rule that the health-related licensing board is empowered to enforce, and continued practice by the regulated person presents an imminent risk of serious harm, the health-related licensing board shall issue an order temporarily suspending the regulated person's authority to practice
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapters 214 - 215 — Examining And Licensing Boards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the terms of the health professionals services program participation agreement or leaving the program without completing it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Each health-related licensing board shall consider it grounds for disciplinary action if a regulated person violates the terms of the health professionals services program participation agreement or leaves the program except upon fulfilling the terms for successful completion of the program
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapters 214 - 215 — Examining And Licensing Boards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a licensee to submit to a required criminal background check.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure of a licensee to submit to a criminal background check as provided in subdivision 3 is grounds for disciplinary action by the respective health-related licensing board.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapters 214 - 215 — Examining And Licensing Boards

board_composition_required.value: Board consists of: a designee of the commissioner of health (nonvoting), a designee of the commissioner of human services (nonvoting), and governor-appointed members including licensed nursing home administrators, health services executives, an assisted living facility director, a physician, two professional nurses, and three public members.
board_composition_required.quote: a designee of the commissioner of health who shall be a nonvoting member; a designee of the commissioner of human services who shall be a nonvoting member; and the following members appointed by the governor: (i) one licensed nursing home administrator member... (ii) one licensed nursing home administrator or health services executive member... (iii) one licensed nursing home administrator or health services executive member... (iv) one licensed assisted living facility director member... (v) one member actively engaged in the practice of medicine; (vi) two members actively engaged in the practice of professional nursing... and (vii) three public members

board_member_term_years.quote: The terms of the members shall be four years with the terms ending on the first Monday in January.
board_member_term_years.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapters 214 - 215 — Examining And Licensing Boards
